name: Fujisaki Yuri
source:
A student with a warm personality who finds it difficult to say "no," and is completely unable to resist when someone asks for her. She is a neat and pretty lady with long, glossy hair stretching down to her waist, but seems weak around men, despite attending the academy since kindergarten.

[Translated from in-game Description]
